pallet-town.name: Pallet Town
pallet-town.description: Start your journey here. Walk north to Route 1.

route-1.name: Route 1
route-1.description: Pidgey and Rattata live in the grass between Pallet Town and Viridian City.

viridian-city.name: Viridian City
viridian-city.description: Route 2 leads north to Viridian Forest. Route 22 branches west.

route-22.name: Route 22
route-22.description: Explore the grass west of Viridian City for Spearow and Mankey.

route-2.name: Route 2
route-2.description: Follow the west-hand gate through Viridian Forest to reach Pewter City.

forest-south-gate.name: Viridian Forest · South Gate
forest-south-gate.description: The northern doorway leads into Viridian Forest.

viridian-forest.name: Viridian Forest
viridian-forest.description: Bug Pokémon shelter beneath the trees. Pikachu is a rare sighting.

forest-north-gate.name: Viridian Forest · North Gate
forest-north-gate.description: Continue north through Route 2 to Pewter City.

pewter-city.name: Pewter City
pewter-city.description: A quiet stop at the foot of Mt. Moon. Route 3 heads east.

route-3.name: Route 3
route-3.description: Follow the hillside east, then north to Route 4 and Mt. Moon.

route-4.name: Route 4
route-4.description: Mt. Moon separates the western trail from the grass leading to Cerulean City. Ledges can be jumped in their marked direction.

mt-moon-1f.name: Mt. Moon · 1F
mt-moon-1f.description: Take the ladders through Mt. Moon. Zubat, Geodude and the occasional Clefairy appear in the cave.

mt-moon-b1f.name: Mt. Moon · B1F
mt-moon-b1f.description: Ladders connect several separate passages. The eastern exit leads back to Route 4.

mt-moon-b2f.name: Mt. Moon · B2F
mt-moon-b2f.description: Explore the deepest chambers, then take the northeastern ladder toward Cerulean City.

cerulean-city.name: Cerulean City
cerulean-city.description: The final town in this first Kanto journey. Visit your PC or return to a place you've explored.
